A.prompt:
Pick exactly 3 different skills from this list (every skill is at level 3, the maximum). Your opponents pick independently.

- freeze: FREEZE: a wave spreads from your ball; enemy teams it reaches are slowed for 6 s. Cooldown 20 s.
- split: SPLIT: your ball becomes 5 balls for 4 s, then the extras vanish. Cooldown 20 s.
- accel: ACCEL: all your balls move x2 for 6 s. Cooldown 8 s.
- bomb: BOMB: for 7 s your main ball also paints 3 neighbouring cell(s) on every bounce. Cooldown 16 s.
- giant: GIANT: your balls get bigger for 3 s and hit more cells per bounce. Cooldown 24 s.
- fire: FIRE: pick a point (x y); after 0.35 s a circle of radius 3 cells around it is painted your colour. Cooldown 20 s.
- lightning: LIGHTNING: from your main ball's cell, four 1-cell-wide lines shoot to the board edges (up/down/left/right) and paint every cell they cross. Cooldown 10 s.
- teleport: TELEPORT: pick a point (x y); your main ball jumps there instantly and paints the landing cell. Any distance. Cooldown 20 s.
- shatter: SHATTER: for 7 s every bounce on a foreign cell spawns a small extra ball that also paints. Cooldown 15 s.
- shock: SHOCKWAVE: an arc of 120 degrees spreads forward from your ball and paints the first non-own cell on every ray. Cooldown 10 s.
- chain: CHAIN LIGHTNING: stuns every enemy ball on the board for 2.5 s (does not paint). Cooldown 14 s.
- snowball: PLASMA: your main ball grows on each hit; after 5 hits the next hit paints a circle around it. Cooldown 14 s.

Reply with brief reasoning (under 80 words), then one last line exactly like this, using the ids as written above:
PICK: <id>, <id>, <id>
A.reply:
Reasoning: Painting output matters most in a 60s game. Lightning has a 10s cooldown and paints up to ~62 cells per cast (6 casts). Split multiplies ball bounces fivefold for 4s every 20s. Accel on an 8s cooldown doubles movement/bounce rate much of the game and stacks with split. These three maximize raw territory gain rather than disruption.

PICK: lightning, split, accel
